_comment: 2026-09-23 altitude tape test. The 09-23 gate flight found the drone 28-41 cm above height? + the site's 18 cm offset, by two optically independent methods, with a residual that grows as the commanded height falls. This mission hovers still at two commanded heights so the operator can tape-measure the camera while it holds: no translation at all (every stop is the start pad, inside the 10 cm dead band), four localisation bursts per height, each logging tag_height_cm beside height?. Place the drone on a tape-marked spot at x 250, y 170 (1.7 m in front of the tag line, mid-width) facing the tags, and measure the lens centre above the floor at each hold. Legs 20 cm/s, one trim. Fly with docs/wp5-flight3-site.json and docs/wp5-flight3-map.json. The holds are at y 170 because the guard refuses a 130 cm hold nearer the tags than that.
